title: Verification Learning Theory: A Process Model of Checking and Retention in AI-Assisted Judgment
abstract: arXiv:2610.37875v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate AI assistance can improve immediate judgments while reducing opportunities to practise the operations needed for independent performance. Verification Learning Theory (VLT) formalises this possibility for claim-evaluation practice followed by correct, independent, rule-specific feedback. The model links perceived assistant reliability to evidence checking and links the history of those checks to retained rule use. Its strict form assumes that task demands and perceived reliability influence learning only through checking, with equal learning per genuine check. It therefore predicts that perceived fallibility can improve delayed unaided judgment even without observed assistant errors, and that this advantage disappears when checking is already required and performed. Rule-specific gains and forecasts from checking histories provide further tests. Simulations examine the consequences and parameter dependence of these commitments;

translated_title: 验证学习理论：AI辅助判断中核查与保持的过程模型
translated_abstract: 准确的AI辅助能够改善即时判断，同时却减少了练习独立完成任务所需操作的机会。验证学习理论（Verification Learning Theory, VLT）针对“论断评估练习，随后获得正确、独立且针对特定规则的反馈”这一场景，对上述可能性进行了形式化建模。该模型将用户感知到的助手可靠性与其对证据的核查行为联系起来，并将核查历史与被保持下来的规则使用联系起来。其严格形式假设：任务要求和感知可靠性只能通过核查来影响学习，且每次真实核查带来的学习量相等。因此，该理论预测：即使没有观察到助手犯错，仅仅感知到助手“可能出错”也能改善延迟的独立判断；而当核查本来就被要求并且已经执行时，这一优势便会消失。针对特定规则的收益以及基于核查历史的预测为进一步检验提供了途径。仿真分析了这些核心承诺的后果及其对参数的依赖性。
tldr: 该论文提出“验证学习理论”（VLT）这一过程模型，将AI助手的感知可靠性与用户核查证据的行为、以及核查历史与规则知识的保持联系起来，并预测即使没有观察到AI实际犯错，仅感知到AI可能出错也能通过促进核查来提升延迟的独立判断能力，但若核查已被强制执行则该优势消失。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Verification Learning Theory (VLT), a process model linking perceived AI reliability to evidence checking and checking history to retained rule use, predicting that perceived AI fallibility can improve delayed unaided judgment even without observed assistant errors—an advantage that vanishes when checking is already required and performed.
